articles.title: Bitget's $352 million hack happened via spoofed transfers, not private keys, CEO Gracy Chen says
articles.snippet: Bitget lost $351.6 million after attackers compromised a wallet backend, spoofed transaction data, Chen said on X.

articles.title: Someone was trying to sell Ondo Finance after founder Nathan Allman's death
articles.snippet: The company has vehemently denied that it was shopping for buyers. Allman’s estate declined to comment.

articles.title: UK’s largest banks complete world’s first interbank transactions using tokenized deposits
articles.snippet: Barclays, NatWest, and HSBC and others used tokenized deposits for remortgages and a marketplace-payment test, taking bank-issued digital cash beyond a single institution.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street and crypto fight for the same turf
articles.snippet: Stablecoins and tokenized assets are pushing banks, exchanges and crypto companies into the same markets, from payments to stocks and ETFs.

articles.title: Crypto treasury model loses its edge as stock premiums fade: DWF
articles.snippet: Most DATs now trade below the value of their crypto holdings, weakening a financing model that once helped companies expand their balance sheets.
